# Let's construct and verify a simple bipartite graph on 16 vertices
# Split into two sets: A = {0,1,...,7}, B = {8,9,...,15}
# Add a perfect matching: 0-8, 1-9, 2-10, 3-11, 4-12, 5-13, 6-14, 7-15

edges = [(i, i + 8) for i in range(8)]
print("Edges:", edges)

# Verify properties
import networkx as nx

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(16))
G.add_edges_from(edges)

# Check 1: All degrees >= 1
degrees = dict(G.degree())
print("Degrees:", degrees)
print("Min degree:", min(degrees.values()))

# Check 2: Chromatic number <= 2 (bipartite check)
is_bip = nx.is_bipartite(G)
print("Is bipartite:", is_bip)

# Check 3: Max clique size <= 2 (no triangles)
cliques = list(nx.find_cliques(G))
max_clique = max(len(c) for c in cliques)
print("Max clique size:", max_clique)

print("\nAll constraints satisfied!" if (min(degrees.values()) >= 1 and is_bip and max_clique <= 2) else "FAILED")
